```{r, echo=FALSE, results='hide'}
library(googledrive)
if (file.exists("../.env")) readRenviron("../.env")
spreadsheet_url <- Sys.getenv("STUDENT_DIRECTORY_URL")
bsa_id <- as_id(spreadsheet_url)
```

```{=html}
// ── Cohort year → year-in-program (update each August) ─────────────────
// '2025' = entered Fall 2025 → currently 1st years
// '2024' = entered Fall 2024 → currently 2nd years
var COHORT_1ST_YEAR = '2025';
var COHORT_2ND_YEAR = '2024';
// Denominators — total enrolled per cohort (not just respondents)
var TOTALS = {
  PhD:  { all: 46 },
  MS:   { '2025': 8,  '2024': 13 },
  MDSH: { '2025': 55, '2024': 44 }
};
</script>

/* ── Reset & Base ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.stats-page { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 1.5rem 5rem; font-family: inherit; }

/* ── Hero ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.stats-hero {

/* ── Setup / Error / Loading states ───────────────────────────────────── */

.state-card code{ background: #e8eef5; padding: 0.15rem 0.4rem; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 0.88rem; color: #003B5C; }

.loading-spinner {
  width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 4px solid #e0eaf3;

}
@keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
.hidden { display: none !important; }

/* ── KPI Cards ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.kpi-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); gap: 1rem; margin-bottom: 2.5rem; }
.kpi-card {

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  /* ── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  var BLUE    = '#2774AE';
  var NAVY    = '#003B5C';
  var GOLD    = '#FFD100';
  var MID     = '#005587';
  var TEAL    = '#00a693';
  var PALETTE = [BLUE, '#e8a000', TEAL, '#8b5cf6', '#ef4444', '#10b981', '#f59e0b', '#6366f1', '#ec4899', '#14b8a6'];

  function el(id)  { return document.getElementById(id); }
  function show(id){ var e = el(id); if (e) e.classList.remove('hidden'); }
  function hide(id){ var e = el(id); if (e) e.classList.add('hidden');    }

  function pct(n, total) {
    if (!total) return '0%';
    return Math.round(n / total * 100) + '%';
  }

  function topN(obj, n) {
    return Object.entries(obj)
      .sort(function (a, b) { return b[1] - a[1]; })
      .slice(0, n);
  }

  /* ── Column finder ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function findCol(cols, keywords) {
    for (var i = 0; i < cols.length; i++) {
      var label = (cols[i].label || '').toLowerCase();
      if (keywords.every(function (kw) { return label.includes(kw.toLowerCase()); })) {
        return i;
      }
    }
    return -1;
  }

  function cellVal(row, idx) {
    if (idx < 0 || !row.c || !row.c[idx] || row.c[idx].v === null || row.c[idx].v === undefined) return '';
    return String(row.c[idx].v).trim();
  }

  /* ── Normalizers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function normalizeProgram(raw) {
    var s = raw.toLowerCase();
    if (s.includes('phd') || s.includes('doctor')) return 'PhD';
    if (s.includes('mdsh') || s.includes('data science in public health')) return 'MDSH';
    if (s.includes('ms') || s.includes('master of science')) return 'MS';
    return raw || 'Unknown';
  }

  function normalizeAdvisor(raw) {
    // Strip honorific prefixes so "Dr. Professor Smith" == "Professor Smith" == "Smith"
    return raw.replace(/^(dr\.?\s*)?(prof\.?|professor)\.?\s*/i, '').trim();
  }

  function normalizeMajor(raw) {
    var m = raw.toLowerCase().trim();
    if (!m) return null;
    if (m.includes('biostatistic')) return 'Biostatistics';
    if (m.includes('statistic') && (m.includes('data science') || m.includes('data analysis'))) return 'Statistics & Data Science';
    if (m.includes('statistic')) return 'Statistics';
    if ((m.includes('math') || m.includes('mathematics')) && (m.includes('econ') || m.includes('economics'))) return 'Mathematics / Economics';
    if (m.includes('math') || m.includes('mathematics')) return 'Mathematics';
    if (m.includes('applied math')) return 'Applied Mathematics';
    if (m.includes('computer science') || m.includes('computing')) return 'Computer Science';
    if (m.includes('biology') || m.includes('molecular bio') || m.includes('life science')) return 'Biology / Life Sciences';
    if (m.includes('biochem')) return 'Biochemistry';
    if (m.includes('chemistry')) return 'Chemistry';
    if (m.includes('physics')) return 'Physics';
    if (m.includes('economics') || m.includes('econ')) return 'Economics';
    if (m.includes('engineering')) return 'Engineering';
    if (m.includes('public health') || m.includes('epidemiology')) return 'Public Health / Epi';
    if (m.includes('neuroscience')) return 'Neuroscience';
    if (m.includes('psychology') || m.includes('cognitive')) return 'Psychology';
    // fallback: title-case
    return raw.split(/[\s\/]+/).map(function (w) {
      return w.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + w.slice(1).toLowerCase();
    }).join(' ');
  }

  function normalizeSchool(raw) {
    if (!raw) return null;
    var s = raw.toLowerCase().trim();
    if (!s) return null;

    // ── UC system — catch all variants first ────────────────────────────
    // "University of California, X" / "UC X" / abbreviations
    var ucMap = {
      'los angeles': 'UCLA', 'ucla': 'UCLA',
      'berkeley': 'UC Berkeley', 'ucb': 'UC Berkeley',
      'davis': 'UC Davis',
      'san diego': 'UC San Diego', 'ucsd': 'UC San Diego',
      'santa barbara': 'UC Santa Barbara', 'ucsb': 'UC Santa Barbara',
      'irvine': 'UC Irvine', 'uci': 'UC Irvine',
      'santa cruz': 'UC Santa Cruz', 'ucsc': 'UC Santa Cruz',
      'riverside': 'UC Riverside', 'ucr': 'UC Riverside',
      'merced': 'UC Merced',
      'san francisco': 'UCSF', 'ucsf': 'UCSF',
    };
    // Strip "university of california" prefix then look up campus
    var stripped = s.replace(/university of california,?\s*/i, '').replace(/^uc\s+/i, '').trim();
    if (ucMap[stripped]) return ucMap[stripped];
    // Also check if the raw string contains a UC keyword
    for (var campus in ucMap) {
      if (s === campus || s === 'uc ' + campus || s.includes('university of california') && s.includes(campus)) {
        return ucMap[campus];
      }
    }

    // ── Other US institutions ─────────────────────────────────────────
    if (s.includes('johns hopkins')) return 'Johns Hopkins University';
    if (s.includes('university of chicago') || s === 'uchicago') return 'University of Chicago';
    if (s.includes('university of north carolina') || s.includes('chapel hill') || s === 'unc') return 'UNC Chapel Hill';
    if (s.includes('university of washington') && !s.includes('st. louis')) return 'U of Washington';
    if (s.includes('university of michigan') || (s.includes('michigan') && !s.includes('state'))) return 'U of Michigan';
    if (s.includes('university of wisconsin') || s.includes('uw-madison') || s.includes('uw–madison')) return 'U of Wisconsin–Madison';
    if (s.includes('university of southern california') || s === 'usc') return 'USC';
    if (s.includes('cal poly')) return 'Cal Poly';
    if (s.includes('pomona college')) return 'Pomona College';
    if (s.includes('brown university') || s === 'brown') return 'Brown University';
    if (s.includes('stanford')) return 'Stanford University';
    if (s.includes('columbia')) return 'Columbia University';
    if (s.includes('nyu') || s.includes('new york university')) return 'NYU';
    if (s.includes('carnegie mellon') || s === 'cmu') return 'Carnegie Mellon';
    if (s.includes('purdue')) return 'Purdue University';
    if (s.includes('notre dame')) return 'Notre Dame';
    if (s.includes('cornell')) return 'Cornell University';
    if (s.includes('imperial college')) return 'Imperial College London';

    // ── Chinese institutions ──────────────────────────────────────────
    if (s.includes('peking university') || s.includes('北京大学') || s === 'pku') return 'Peking University';
    if (s.includes('nankai')) return 'Nankai University';
    if (s.includes('southern university of science') || s.includes('sustech') || s.includes('shenzhen')) return 'Southern Univ. of Sci. & Tech.';
    if (s.includes('east china normal')) return 'East China Normal University';
    if (s.includes('chinese university of hong kong') || s === 'cuhk') return 'Chinese Univ. of Hong Kong';
    if (s.includes('kyoto')) return 'Kyoto University';

    // ── Generic cleanup ───────────────────────────────────────────────
    var clean = raw.trim().replace(/^The\s+/i, '');
    return clean.length > 32 ? clean.slice(0, 30) + '…' : clean;
  }

  function parseLocation(raw) {
    if (!raw) return { country: null, state: null };
    var parts = raw.split(',').map(function (p) { return p.trim(); });
    var last  = (parts[parts.length - 1] || '').toLowerCase().trim();

    // ── US state lookup (abbreviations + full names) ───────────────────
    var US_STATES = {
      al:1,ak:1,az:1,ar:1,ca:1,co:1,ct:1,de:1,fl:1,ga:1,hi:1,id:1,il:1,'in':1,
      ia:1,ks:1,ky:1,la:1,me:1,md:1,ma:1,mi:1,mn:1,mo:1,mt:1,ne:1,nv:1,
      nh:1,nj:1,nm:1,ny:1,nc:1,nd:1,oh:1,ok:1,or:1,pa:1,ri:1,sc:1,sd:1,tn:1,
      tx:1,ut:1,vt:1,va:1,wa:1,wv:1,wi:1,wy:1,dc:1,
      // Full state names
      alabama:1,alaska:1,arizona:1,arkansas:1,california:1,colorado:1,
      connecticut:1,delaware:1,florida:1,georgia:1,hawaii:1,idaho:1,illinois:1,
      indiana:1,iowa:1,kansas:1,kentucky:1,louisiana:1,maine:1,maryland:1,
      massachusetts:1,michigan:1,minnesota:1,mississippi:1,missouri:1,montana:1,
      nebraska:1,nevada:1,'new hampshire':1,'new jersey':1,'new mexico':1,
      'new york':1,'north carolina':1,'north dakota':1,ohio:1,oklahoma:1,
      oregon:1,pennsylvania:1,'rhode island':1,'south carolina':1,'south dakota':1,
      tennessee:1,texas:1,utah:1,vermont:1,virginia:1,washington:1,
      'west virginia':1,wisconsin:1,wyoming:1,'district of columbia':1
    };

    // ── State name → 2-letter abbreviation ────────────────────────────
    var STATE_ABBR = {
      alabama:'AL',alaska:'AK',arizona:'AZ',arkansas:'AR',california:'CA',
      colorado:'CO',connecticut:'CT',delaware:'DE',florida:'FL',georgia:'GA',
      hawaii:'HI',idaho:'ID',illinois:'IL',indiana:'IN',iowa:'IA',
      kansas:'KS',kentucky:'KY',louisiana:'LA',maine:'ME',maryland:'MD',
      massachusetts:'MA',michigan:'MI',minnesota:'MN',mississippi:'MS',
      missouri:'MO',montana:'MT',nebraska:'NE',nevada:'NV',
      'new hampshire':'NH','new jersey':'NJ','new mexico':'NM','new york':'NY',
      'north carolina':'NC','north dakota':'ND',ohio:'OH',oklahoma:'OK',
      oregon:'OR',pennsylvania:'PA','rhode island':'RI','south carolina':'SC',
      'south dakota':'SD',tennessee:'TN',texas:'TX',utah:'UT',vermont:'VT',
      virginia:'VA',washington:'WA','west virginia':'WV',wisconsin:'WI',
      wyoming:'WY','district of columbia':'DC'
    };
    function toStateAbbr(raw) {
      var lo = raw.toLowerCase().trim();
      if (lo === 'united states' || lo === 'usa' || lo === 'u.s.' || lo === 'u.s.a.') return null;
      if (/^[A-Z]{2}$/.test(raw.trim())) return raw.trim();
      return STATE_ABBR[lo] || raw.trim();
    }

    // ── US state abbreviation (2 uppercase letters) ────────────────────
    if (/^[A-Z]{2}$/.test(parts[parts.length - 1])) {
      return { country: 'United States', state: parts[parts.length - 1] };
    }

    if (US_STATES[last] || last === 'usa' || last === 'united states' || last === 'u.s.') {
      return { country: 'United States', state: toStateAbbr(parts[parts.length - 1]) };
    }

    // ── Country matching ───────────────────────────────────────────────
    var COUNTRIES = {
      china: 'China', 'hong kong': 'Hong Kong',
      'united kingdom': 'United Kingdom', england: 'United Kingdom',
      scotland: 'United Kingdom', wales: 'United Kingdom', uk: 'United Kingdom',
      canada: 'Canada', japan: 'Japan',
      'south korea': 'South Korea', korea: 'South Korea',
      india: 'India', australia: 'Australia', germany: 'Germany',
      france: 'France', spain: 'Spain', italy: 'Italy',
      netherlands: 'Netherlands', sweden: 'Sweden', switzerland: 'Switzerland',
      singapore: 'Singapore', taiwan: 'Taiwan',
      philippines: 'Philippines', indonesia: 'Indonesia', thailand: 'Thailand',
      vietnam: 'Vietnam', malaysia: 'Malaysia', bangladesh: 'Bangladesh',
      'sri lanka': 'Sri Lanka', pakistan: 'Pakistan', nepal: 'Nepal',
      brazil: 'Brazil', mexico: 'Mexico', colombia: 'Colombia',
      argentina: 'Argentina', chile: 'Chile', peru: 'Peru',
      nigeria: 'Nigeria', ghana: 'Ghana', kenya: 'Kenya',
      egypt: 'Egypt', iran: 'Iran', turkey: 'Turkey',
      'new zealand': 'New Zealand', ireland: 'Ireland', portugal: 'Portugal',
      greece: 'Greece', poland: 'Poland', russia: 'Russia', ukraine: 'Ukraine'
    };

    // Check last part exactly, then substring
    if (COUNTRIES[last]) return { country: COUNTRIES[last], state: null };
    for (var c in COUNTRIES) {
      if (last.includes(c)) return { country: COUNTRIES[c], state: null };
    }

    // Fallback: return the raw string as country (better than silently wrong)
    return { country: parts[parts.length - 1] || raw, state: null };
  }

  /* ── Chart factory ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  var chartInstances = {};

  function makeDonut(canvasId, labels, data, colors) {
    var ctx = el(canvasId);
    if (!ctx) return;
    if (chartInstances[canvasId]) chartInstances[canvasId].destroy();
    chartInstances[canvasId] = new Chart(ctx, {
      type: 'doughnut',
      data: { labels: labels, datasets: [{ data: data, backgroundColor: colors, borderWidth: 2, borderColor: '#fff', hoverOffset: 6 }] },
      options: {
        responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, cutout: '62%',
        plugins: {
          legend: { position: 'bottom', labels: { padding: 16, font: { size: 12 }, color: '#444', usePointStyle: true, pointStyleWidth: 10 } },
          tooltip: { callbacks: { label: function (ctx) { var s = ctx.parsed; var t = ctx.dataset.data.reduce(function (a, b) { return a + b; }, 0); return ' ' + ctx.label + ': ' + s + ' (' + pct(s, t) + ')'; } } }
        }
      }
    });
  }

  function makeBar(canvasId, labels, data, colors, horizontal) {
    var ctx = el(canvasId);
    if (!ctx) return;
    if (chartInstances[canvasId]) chartInstances[canvasId].destroy();
    var colorArr = Array.isArray(colors) ? colors : labels.map(function (_, i) { return PALETTE[i % PALETTE.length]; });
    chartInstances[canvasId] = new Chart(ctx, {
      type: horizontal ? 'bar' : 'bar',
      data: { labels: labels, datasets: [{ data: data, backgroundColor: colorArr, borderRadius: 6, borderSkipped: false }] },
      options: {
        indexAxis: horizontal ? 'y' : 'x',
        responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false,
        plugins: { legend: { display: false }, tooltip: { callbacks: { label: function (c) { return ' ' + c.parsed[horizontal ? 'x' : 'y'] + ' students'; } } } },
        scales: {
          x: { grid: { color: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.05)' }, ticks: { color: '#555', font: { size: 11 } } },
          y: { grid: { color: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.05)' }, ticks: { color: '#555', font: { size: 11 } } }
        }
      }
    });
  }

  function makeHBar(canvasId, labels, data, color) {
    var ctx = el(canvasId);
    if (!ctx) return;
    if (chartInstances[canvasId]) chartInstances[canvasId].destroy();
    chartInstances[canvasId] = new Chart(ctx, {
      type: 'bar',
      data: {
        labels: labels,
        datasets: [{ data: data, backgroundColor: color || BLUE, borderRadius: 5, borderSkipped: false }]
      },
      options: {
        indexAxis: 'y',
        responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false,
        plugins: { legend: { display: false }, tooltip: { callbacks: { label: function (c) { return ' ' + c.parsed.x + ' students'; } } } },
        scales: {
          x: { beginAtZero: true, grid: { color: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.05)' }, ticks: { color: '#555', stepSize: 1 } },
          y: { grid: { display: false }, ticks: { color: '#333', font: { size: 12 } } }
        }
      }
    });
  }

  function makeStackedBar(canvasId, labels, datasets) {
    var ctx = el(canvasId);
    if (!ctx) return;
    if (chartInstances[canvasId]) chartInstances[canvasId].destroy();
    chartInstances[canvasId] = new Chart(ctx, {
      type: 'bar',
      data: {
        labels: labels,
        datasets: datasets.map(function (d) {
          return { label: d.label, data: d.data, backgroundColor: d.color, borderRadius: 4, borderSkipped: false };
        })
      },
      options: {
        responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false,
        plugins: {
          legend: { position: 'bottom', labels: { padding: 14, font: { size: 11 }, color: '#444', usePointStyle: true, pointStyleWidth: 10 } },
          tooltip: { mode: 'index', intersect: false }
        },
        scales: {
          x: { stacked: true, grid: { color: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.05)' }, ticks: { color: '#555' } },
          y: { stacked: true, grid: { color: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.05)' }, ticks: { color: '#555', stepSize: 1 } }
        }
      }
    });
  }

  function makeStackedHBar(canvasId, labels, datasets) {
    var ctx = el(canvasId);
    if (!ctx) return;
    if (chartInstances[canvasId]) chartInstances[canvasId].destroy();
    chartInstances[canvasId] = new Chart(ctx, {
      type: 'bar',
      data: {
        labels: labels,
        datasets: datasets.map(function (d) {
          return { label: d.label, data: d.data, backgroundColor: d.color, borderRadius: 4, borderSkipped: false };
        })
      },
      options: {
        indexAxis: 'y',
        responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false,
        plugins: {
          legend: { position: 'bottom', labels: { padding: 14, font: { size: 11 }, color: '#444', usePointStyle: true, pointStyleWidth: 10 } },
          tooltip: { mode: 'index', intersect: false, callbacks: { label: function (c) { return ' ' + c.dataset.label + ': ' + c.parsed.x; } } }
        },
        scales: {
          x: { stacked: true, beginAtZero: true, grid: { color: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.05)' }, ticks: { color: '#555', stepSize: 1 } },
          y: { stacked: true, grid: { display: false }, ticks: { color: '#333', font: { size: 12 } } }
        }
      }
    });
  }

  /* ── Global state ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  var _rows        = [];   // active (non-alumni) rows, parsed once
  var _alumniCount = 0;    // total alumni responses (shown separately, never filtered)
  var _sel  = { PhD: true, MS: true, MDSH: true };

  /* ── Alumni detection — MS/MDSH beyond 2nd year cohort are alumni ───── */
  function isAlumni(r) {
    if (r.program === 'PhD') return false;
    var yr     = parseInt(r.cohortYear) || 0;
    var minYr  = parseInt(window.COHORT_2ND_YEAR) || 2024;
    return yr > 0 && yr < minYr;
  }

  /* ── Parse sheet → structured row objects (runs once on load) ────────── */
  function processData(tableData) {
    var cols = tableData.cols;
    var raw  = tableData.rows || [];

    var idx = {
      program:     findCol(cols, ['degree program']),
      candidacy:   findCol(cols, ['candidacy']),
      cohort:      findCol(cols, ['quarter']),
      advisor:     findCol(cols, ['advisor']),
      advisorType: findCol(cols, ['is this adv']),
      bsMajor:     findCol(cols, ['bachelor', 'major']),
      bsSchool:    findCol(cols, ['Bachelor', 'school']),
      bsLoc:       findCol(cols, ['bachelor', 'location']),
      msName:      findCol(cols, ['master', 'name']),
      msSchool:    findCol(cols, ['master', 'school']),
      linkedin:    findCol(cols, ['linkedin']),
      github:      findCol(cols, ['github']),
      website:     findCol(cols, ['personal website']),
      bio:         findCol(cols, ['description']),
    };

    _rows = raw.filter(function (r) { return r.c; }).map(function (r) {
      var advRaw = cellVal(r, idx.advisor);
      var advs   = advRaw
        ? advRaw.split(/,|and(?=\s+[A-Z])/i).map(function (a) { return normalizeAdvisor(a.trim()); }).filter(function (a) { return a.length > 2; })
        : [];
      var yrM = cellVal(r, idx.cohort).match(/\d{4}/);
      return {
        program:     normalizeProgram(cellVal(r, idx.program)),
        candidacy:   cellVal(r, idx.candidacy).toLowerCase(),
        cohortYear:  yrM ? yrM[0] : '',
        hasMasters:  !!(cellVal(r, idx.msName) || cellVal(r, idx.msSchool)),
        bsMajor:     normalizeMajor(cellVal(r, idx.bsMajor)),
        bsSchool:    normalizeSchool(cellVal(r, idx.bsSchool)),
        bsLoc:       parseLocation(cellVal(r, idx.bsLoc)),
        advisors:    advs,
        advisorType: cellVal(r, idx.advisorType).toLowerCase(),
        linkedin:    !!cellVal(r, idx.linkedin),
        github:      !!cellVal(r, idx.github),
        website:     !!cellVal(r, idx.website),
        bio:         !!cellVal(r, idx.bio),
      };
    });

    // Split into alumni vs active — MS/MDSH beyond 2nd-year cohort are alumni
    _alumniCount = _rows.filter(isAlumni).length;
    _rows        = _rows.filter(function (r) { return !isAlumni(r); });

    // Completion rates — always from full dataset, independent of filter
    function fillCompletion(pctId, fracId, barId, resp, total) {
      var p = Math.round(resp / total * 100);
      el(pctId).textContent = p + '%';
      el(fracId).textContent = resp + ' / ' + total;
      el(barId).style.width = Math.min(p, 100) + '%';
    }
    var T = window.TOTALS;
    var Y1 = window.COHORT_1ST_YEAR, Y2 = window.COHORT_2ND_YEAR;
    fillCompletion('phdCompletePct',  'phdCompleteFrac',  'phdCompleteBar',
      _rows.filter(function (r) { return r.program === 'PhD'; }).length, T.PhD.all);
    fillCompletion('ms1CompletePct',  'ms1CompleteFrac',  'ms1CompleteBar',
      _rows.filter(function (r) { return r.program === 'MS'   && r.cohortYear === Y1; }).length, T.MS[Y1]);
    fillCompletion('ms2CompletePct',  'ms2CompleteFrac',  'ms2CompleteBar',
      _rows.filter(function (r) { return r.program === 'MS'   && r.cohortYear === Y2; }).length, T.MS[Y2]);
    fillCompletion('mdsh1CompletePct','mdsh1CompleteFrac','mdsh1CompleteBar',
      _rows.filter(function (r) { return r.program === 'MDSH' && r.cohortYear === Y1; }).length, T.MDSH[Y1]);
    fillCompletion('mdsh2CompletePct','mdsh2CompleteFrac','mdsh2CompleteBar',
      _rows.filter(function (r) { return r.program === 'MDSH' && r.cohortYear === Y2; }).length, T.MDSH[Y2]);

    var lu = el('lastUpdated');
    if (lu) lu.textContent = 'Last loaded: ' + new Date().toLocaleString();

    // KPIs are always computed from full _rows — not affected by filter
    renderKPIs();
    setupFilters();
    renderAll();
    hide('loadingCard');
    show('statsContent');
  }

  /* ── KPI cards — always full _rows, never filtered ───────────────────── */
  function renderKPIs() {
    var programs  = {};
    var candidacy = { Candidate: 0 };
    _rows.forEach(function (r) {
      programs[r.program] = (programs[r.program] || 0) + 1;
      if (r.program === 'PhD' && r.candidacy === 'yes') candidacy.Candidate++;
    });
    el('kpiTotal').textContent  = _rows.length;
    el('kpiPhd').textContent    = programs['PhD']  || 0;
    el('kpiMs').textContent     = programs['MS']   || 0;
    el('kpiMdsh').textContent   = programs['MDSH'] || 0;
    el('kpiAlumni').textContent = _alumniCount;
    var candSub = el('kpiCandSub');
    if (candSub) candSub.textContent = candidacy.Candidate > 0
      ? 'incl. ' + candidacy.Candidate + ' candidates' : '';
  }

  /* ── Filter buttons ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function setupFilters() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var prog = btn.getAttribute('data-prog');
        if (prog === 'all') {
          _sel = { PhD: true, MS: true, MDSH: true };
        } else {
          _sel[prog] = !_sel[prog];
          // Never allow nothing selected — snap back to all
          if (!_sel.PhD && !_sel.MS && !_sel.MDSH) {
            _sel = { PhD: true, MS: true, MDSH: true };
          }
        }
        syncFilterBtns();
        renderAll();
      });
    });
    syncFilterBtns();

    // Advisor chart / list toggle
    var togBtn = el('advisorViewToggle');
    if (togBtn) {
      togBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var chartWrap = el('advisorChartWrap');
        var listWrap  = el('advisorListWrap');
        if (listWrap.classList.contains('hidden')) {
          listWrap.classList.remove('hidden');
          chartWrap.classList.add('hidden');
          togBtn.textContent = 'Show Chart';
        } else {
          listWrap.classList.add('hidden');
          chartWrap.classList.remove('hidden');
          togBtn.textContent = 'Show List';
        }
      });
    }
  }

  function syncFilterBtns() {
    var allOn = _sel.PhD && _sel.MS && _sel.MDSH;
    document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(function (btn) {
      var prog = btn.getAttribute('data-prog');
      btn.classList.toggle('active', prog === 'all' ? allOn : !!_sel[prog]);
    });
    var fc = el('filterCount');
    if (fc) {
      if (allOn) {
        fc.textContent = 'Showing all ' + _rows.length + ' students';
      } else {
        var names = Object.keys(_sel).filter(function (k) { return _sel[k]; });
        var count = _rows.filter(function (r) { return _sel[r.program]; }).length;
        fc.textContent = 'Showing ' + count + ' students (' + names.join(' + ') + ')';
      }
    }
  }

  /* ── Render all charts from current filter selection ─────────────────── */
  function renderAll() {
    var filtered = _rows.filter(function (r) { return _sel[r.program]; });
    var total    = filtered.length;

    var programs      = {};
    var cohortByYear  = {};  // { year: { PhD:0, MS:0, MDSH:0 } }
    var phdHasMasters = { "Has Master's": 0, "No Master's": 0 };
    var candidacy     = { Candidate: 0, Student: 0 };
    var bsMajors      = {};
    var bsSchools     = {};
    var countries     = {};
    var usStates      = {};
    var advisorBreakdown = {}; // { name: { Research:0, Academic:0 } }
    var advisorTypes  = { Research: 0, Academic: 0, Other: 0 };
    var multiAdvisor  = 0;
    var phdTotal      = 0;

    filtered.forEach(function (r) {
      programs[r.program] = (programs[r.program] || 0) + 1;
      if (r.program === 'PhD') phdTotal++;
      if (r.cohortYear) {
        if (!cohortByYear[r.cohortYear]) cohortByYear[r.cohortYear] = { PhD: 0, MS: 0, MDSH: 0 };
        cohortByYear[r.cohortYear][r.program] = (cohortByYear[r.cohortYear][r.program] || 0) + 1;
      }
      if (r.program === 'PhD') {
        phdHasMasters[r.hasMasters ? "Has Master's" : "No Master's"]++;
        if (r.candidacy === 'yes') candidacy.Candidate++;
        else if (r.candidacy === 'no') candidacy.Student++;
      }
      if (r.bsMajor)  bsMajors[r.bsMajor]   = (bsMajors[r.bsMajor]   || 0) + 1;
      if (r.bsSchool) bsSchools[r.bsSchool]  = (bsSchools[r.bsSchool] || 0) + 1;
      if (r.bsLoc.country) {
        countries[r.bsLoc.country] = (countries[r.bsLoc.country] || 0) + 1;
        if (r.bsLoc.country === 'United States' && r.bsLoc.state)
          usStates[r.bsLoc.state] = (usStates[r.bsLoc.state] || 0) + 1;
      }
      var advType = r.advisorType.includes('research') ? 'Research'
                  : r.advisorType.includes('academic') ? 'Academic' : null;
      if (advType) advisorTypes[advType]++;
      else if (r.advisorType) advisorTypes.Other++;
      r.advisors.forEach(function (a) {
        if (!advisorBreakdown[a]) advisorBreakdown[a] = { Research: 0, Academic: 0 };
        advisorBreakdown[a][advType || 'Research']++;
      });
      if (r.advisors.length > 1) multiAdvisor++;
    });

    // Insight pills
    var insightData = _sel.PhD
      ? [
          { num: pct(phdHasMasters["Has Master's"], phdTotal || 1), text: 'of PhD students came with a prior Master\'s degree' },
          { num: pct(multiAdvisor, total),                          text: 'have more than one faculty advisor' },
          { num: pct(countries['United States'] || 0, total),       text: 'did their undergrad at a US institution' },
          { num: pct(candidacy.Candidate, phdTotal || 1),           text: 'of PhD students have advanced to candidacy' }
        ]
      : [
          { num: pct(countries['United States'] || 0, total), text: 'did their undergrad at a US institution' },
          { num: pct(advisorTypes.Research, total),            text: 'have a research advisor' }
        ];
    var ir = el('insightRow');
    if (ir) ir.innerHTML = insightData.map(function (d) {
      return '<div class="insight-pill"><div class="insight-num">' + d.num + '</div><div class="insight-text">' + d.text + '</div></div>';
    }).join('');

    // Charts
    var progLabels = Object.keys(programs);
    makeDonut('chartProgram', progLabels, progLabels.map(function (l) { return programs[l]; }),
      progLabels.map(function (l) { return l === 'PhD' ? BLUE : l === 'MS' ? MID : l === 'MDSH' ? TEAL : '#999'; }));

    var sortedYears = Object.keys(cohortByYear).sort();
    makeStackedBar('chartCohort', sortedYears, [
      { label: 'PhD',  data: sortedYears.map(function (y) { return cohortByYear[y].PhD  || 0; }), color: BLUE },
      { label: 'MS',   data: sortedYears.map(function (y) { return cohortByYear[y].MS   || 0; }), color: MID  },
      { label: 'MDSH', data: sortedYears.map(function (y) { return cohortByYear[y].MDSH || 0; }), color: TEAL }
    ]);

    // Show/hide PhD-only charts
    var phdRow = el('phdChartsRow');
    if (phdRow) phdRow.style.display = _sel.PhD ? '' : 'none';

    makeDonut('chartMasters', Object.keys(phdHasMasters), Object.values(phdHasMasters), [BLUE, '#e0e7ef']);

    var candLabels = ['Candidate', 'Student'];
    makeDonut('chartCandidacy', candLabels, candLabels.map(function (l) { return candidacy[l]; }), ['#e8a000', '#e0e7ef']);

    var topMajors = topN(bsMajors, 10);
    makeHBar('chartMajors', topMajors.map(function (e) { return e[0]; }), topMajors.map(function (e) { return e[1]; }), BLUE);

    var topSchools = topN(bsSchools, 10);
    makeHBar('chartSchools', topSchools.map(function (e) { return e[0]; }), topSchools.map(function (e) { return e[1]; }), MID);

    var topCountries = topN(countries, 6);
    makeDonut('chartGeo', topCountries.map(function (e) { return e[0]; }), topCountries.map(function (e) { return e[1]; }),
      [BLUE, '#e8a000', TEAL, '#8b5cf6', '#ef4444', '#10b981']);

    var topStates = topN(usStates, 8);
    makeHBar('chartStates', topStates.map(function (e) { return e[0]; }), topStates.map(function (e) { return e[1]; }), TEAL);

    var topAdvList = Object.entries(advisorBreakdown)
      .map(function (e) { return { name: e[0], r: e[1].Research, a: e[1].Academic, total: e[1].Research + e[1].Academic }; })
      .sort(function (a, b) { return b.total - a.total; })
      .slice(0, 10);
    makeStackedHBar('chartAdvisors', topAdvList.map(function (e) { return e.name; }), [
      { label: 'Research', data: topAdvList.map(function (e) { return e.r; }), color: BLUE },
      { label: 'Academic', data: topAdvList.map(function (e) { return e.a; }), color: '#e8a000' }
    ]);

    var advTypeLabels = Object.keys(advisorTypes).filter(function (k) { return advisorTypes[k] > 0; });
    makeDonut('chartAdvisorType', advTypeLabels, advTypeLabels.map(function (k) { return advisorTypes[k]; }),
      [BLUE, '#e8a000', TEAL]);

    // Faculty list view (all advisors, not just top 10)
    var allAdvList = Object.entries(advisorBreakdown)
      .map(function (e) { return { name: e[0], r: e[1].Research, a: e[1].Academic, total: e[1].Research + e[1].Academic }; })
      .sort(function (a, b) { return b.total - a.total; });
    var listEl = el('advisorListContent');
    if (listEl) listEl.innerHTML = allAdvList.map(function (adv) {
      var parts = [];
      if (adv.r) parts.push(adv.r + ' research');
      if (adv.a) parts.push(adv.a + ' academic');
      return '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:0.45rem 0.25rem;border-bottom:1px solid #f0f4f8;">'
        + '<span style="font-weight:500;color:#1a2744;">' + adv.name + '</span>'
        + '<span style="color:#555;font-size:0.88rem;">' + adv.total + ' student' + (adv.total !== 1 ? 's' : '')
        + (parts.length ? ' <span style="color:#999;font-size:0.82rem;">(' + parts.join(', ') + ')</span>' : '')
        + '</span></div>';
    }).join('');
  }

  /* ── JSONP loader ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function loadSheet(sheetId) {
    if (!sheetId || sheetId === 'YOUR_SHEET_ID_HERE') {
      hide('loadingCard');
      show('setupCard');
      return;
    }

    var cbName = '_bsaStatsData_' + Date.now();
    var timeout = setTimeout(function () {
      hide('loadingCard');
      el('errorMsg').textContent = 'Request timed out. Check the Sheet ID and sharing settings.';
      show('errorCard');
    }, 12000);

    window[cbName] = function (data) {
      clearTimeout(timeout);
      delete window[cbName];
      if (!data || !data.table) {
        hide('loadingCard');
        el('errorMsg').textContent = 'Sheet returned no data. Make sure it\'s shared as "Anyone with the link can view."';
        show('errorCard');
        return;
      }
      try {
        processData(data.table);
      } catch (e) {
        hide('loadingCard');
        el('errorMsg').textContent = 'Error parsing data: ' + e.message;
        show('errorCard');
      }
    };

    var script = document.createElement('script');
    script.onerror = function () {
      clearTimeout(timeout);
      hide('loadingCard');
      el('errorMsg').textContent = 'Could not reach Google Sheets. Check the Sheet ID and make sure the sheet is shared publicly.';
      show('errorCard');
    };
    script.src = 'https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/' + sheetId +
                 '/gviz/tq?tqx=out:json;responseHandler:' + cbName;
    document.head.appendChild(script);
  }

  // Kick off
  loadSheet(window.BSA_SHEET_ID);

})();
</script>
```
